name: kq-app-create-track
description: Call tool 'ciq_execute' with arguments: id: "<this query's id>", input_params: {track_external_id: (required) external_id for the new Track, track_title: (required) Track title, track_loudness: (required) loudness value}. Auth: X-IK-ClientKey only (_Application subject), no Bearer token, $_appId is auto-filled. Returns: the created Track node.
